Section 3 of EO 13385 of September 29, 2005 (70 FR 57989, published October 4, 2005)  revokes the order by number and lists it among orders that established committees which the revoking order describes as terminated or with completed work; the revoking text reads "(a) Executive Order 13328, establishing the Commission on the Intelligence 
Capabilities of the United States Regarding Weapons of Mass Destruction;" Section 6 of EO 13385 makes that order effective September 30, 2005, so the revocation took effect on that date. The clause therefore ended on 2005-09-30.

research_rationale:
EO 13328 established the Commission on the Intelligence Capabilities of the United States Regarding Weapons of Mass Destruction and contains no provision other than those of a commission order (membership, mission, administration, reports, termination). Its termination clause reads "Sec. 8. Termination. The Commission shall terminate within 60 days after 
submitting its report." That clause is triggered by the date of a report and is not an end under owner ruling 2026-10-21-report-deadline; the report date is not held in any source in the repository, so it is disclosed here and not recorded as an end. Section 3 of EO 13385 of September 29, 2005 (70 FR 57989, published October 4, 2005)  revokes the order by number with the words "(a) Executive Order 13328, establishing the Commission on the Intelligence 
Capabilities of the United States Regarding Weapons of Mass Destruction;" and the first dated end held is 2005-09-30.

savings.reason: Section 3 of EO 13385 of September 29, 2005 (70 FR 57989, published October 4, 2005) revokes EO 13328 by number and contains no saving provision for it. The order created an advisory commission and directed support and reports for it; no continuing independent command or accrued obligation is shown in the held texts.
